name: holiday-hacker
description: Holiday Hacker - Android wrapper for the existing HTML/CSS/JS travel planner with native loud alarms.

scripts.serve: npm run sync:www && npx --yes serve www -l 5173
scripts.android:copy: npm run sync:www && npx cap copy android
scripts.android:sync: npm run sync:www && npm run android:icon && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:release:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.android:release:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease
